LESSON: NETBALL

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.5: Netball
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Netball, part of Creating and Performing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of dodging and marking skill in a game of Netball?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe the execution of different passes in Netball,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Netball in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. perform passes in netball for skill acquisition,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Netball in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. execute dodging and marking in Netball for skill development,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Netball in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. perform footwork skills in Netball game situation

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Netball in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. describe the execution of different passes in Netball,

   Netball helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. perform passes in netball for skill acquisition,

   Netball helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. execute dodging and marking in Netball for skill development,

   Netball helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. perform footwork skills in Netball game situation

   Netball helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Observe a virtual or actual Netball game for analysis of skills. Learners with postural defects or short stature could be appropriately positioned for comfort and clear view. Screen resolution and light intensity could be regulated for learners who are sensitive to light 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Observe a virtual or actual Netball game for analysis of skills. Learners with postural defects or short stature could be appropriately positioned for comfort and clear view. Screen resolution and light intensity could be regulated for learners who are sensitive to light 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Netball together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to Learn: the learner analyses and demonstrates the skills of Netball passes, footwork, dodging and marking as

observed.

• Communication and communication: the learner communicates when practicing different passes and shares ideas on the

different Netball skills with peers.

• Digital Literacy: the learner strengthens digital literacy through accessing information virtually to execution of netball

skills.

Values:
• Unity: the learner values each other's effort while playing a Netball mini game collaboratively.

• Integrity: the learner prioritise fair play during skill acquisition in Netball game.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
PCIs:

Health promotion issues: the learner gains physical fitness through performance and practise in Netball for prevention of

lifestyle diseases.

Link to other learning areas

Mathematics: passing the ball involves quick calculations of distances and angles. The learner applies mathematical concepts

to determine the most efficient paths and angles, reinforcing practical mathematical application.
